name: Mehmed Paša Sokolović Bridge in Višegrad
description: This graceful stone bridge spans the Drina River at Višegrad in eastern Bosnia and Herzegovina. Completed in 1577 to designs by the great Ottoman architect Mimar Sinan, it stretches 179.5 metres on eleven arches, with a four-arch ramp meeting it at a right angle on the left bank. Commissioned by Grand Vizier Mehmed Paša Sokolović, it is admired for its elegant proportions.
